findings.evidence: Proof body at DimensionShifting.lean:104-106 uses only `AddCommGroup.zmodModule` (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/ZMod.lean:44) and `Module.Baer.of_addEquiv_zmod` (TauCeti/Algebra/Module/ZMod/Injective.lean:67); no such combined lemma exists in the repo or Mathlib (grep for `zmodModule`/`Baer.*zmod` returns only the ad-hoc per-site constructions at ProP/ZModTwist.lean:189,202, Prescription/SecondCohomology.lean:163-166, Prescription/CompatibleSystem.lean:111).
findings.fix: Generalize to `theorem Module.Baer.exists_module_of_addEquiv_zmod {n} [NeZero n] {W} [AddCommGroup W] (e : W ≃+ ZMod n) : ∃ _ : Module (ZMod n) W, Module.Baer (ZMod n) W`, relocate it public into `TauCeti/Algebra/Module/ZMod/Injective.lean` beside `Module.Baer.of_addEquiv_zmod`, and call it here.
findings.issue: `private theorem exists_module_baer_H2` is general infrastructure hidden in this file: its statement `∃ _ : Module (ZMod n) (H2 G N), Module.Baer (ZMod n) (H2 G N)` uses `H2 G N` only as an opaque `AddCommGroup`, and its proof touches nothing cohomological. Any downstream file holding `H²(G, N) ≃+ ZMod n` (e.g. `N = μₙ`) must re-derive it to feed the four lemmas, which demand `[Module (ZMod n) (H2 G N)]` plus `Module.Baer`.

findings.issue: `dualityMap1_bijective_of_injective_of_addEquiv_zmod` and `dualityMap2_bijective_of_injective_of_addEquiv_zmod` (line 1102) require `[Finite N]`, which `e : N ≃+ ZMod n` and `[NeZero n]` already give — `dualityMap0_bijective_of_injective_of_addEquiv_zmod` derives it on line 1055. The family's three members therefore present different hypotheses for the same fact, and callers with abstract `N` must manufacture the instance (DimensionShifting.lean:179,192,204).

summary: The new surface is otherwise minimal and shim-free, but a purely general ZMod-module/Baer existence lemma is hidden as private in the new file instead of being generalized and exported to its canonical home, and the three counting lemmas disagree on a redundant `[Finite N]` hypothesis.
